_comment: Three boxes of different sizes, plus a cloud route as a fourth lane group. Total lanes must stay <= 8 (dsh's live-subagent cap). See docs/LAYOUT.md.

servers.name: big
servers.note: The fastest box; critic and writer run here

servers.name: mid
servers.note: No vision: never give it a task that needs frames or pictures

servers.name: small
servers.note: A smaller model with a short context and no conversation cache: give it fact checks, not broad research

servers.name: cloud
servers.note: A paid cloud route: fast and parallel, but every token costs money; use it when the queue is long
